item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)
Issued at 05:00 PM 23 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #Catanduanes, #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion, Goa, SanJose, Tigaon, Sagñay), #Albay(Polangui, Oas, CityOfLigao, Guinobatan, Camalig, Jovellar, PioDuran, Tiwi), #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, Castilla, Magallanes, Juban, Casiguran, Barcelona, Bulusan, Irosin, SantaMagdalena), #NorthernSamar(Catarman, Bobon, SanJose, Rosario, Lavezares, Biri and Allen) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Malinao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Bacacay, RapuRapu, SantoDomingo, Daraga, LegazpiCity, Manito), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz and Gubat) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 PM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:00 AM 23 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Masbate(Mobo, CityOfMasbate, Milagros, Uson, Batuan, SanFernando) and #NorthernSamar(SanVicente) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
